description: For traders and job shops: takes the customer request (item, customer, quantity, unit, customer deadline), the mark-up and optional supplier offers (supplier, unit price, delivery days, valid until). Returns a dated route (send request today, reminder, compare, offer to the customer), the offers with validity and lead time checks, the cheapest valid offer, the selling price with mark-up and gross margin, and RFQ and reminder texts in German and English to copy. Nothing is sent. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

customer_deadline.description: Date the customer expects the offer, YYYY-MM-DD.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

margin.description: Mark-up on the purchase price in percent. Default 15.

offers.description: Optional supplier offers: supplier, unit_price, delivery_days, valid_until (YYYY-MM-DD). German column names work too.

unit.description: Unit, for example piece or kg.

name: plan_request_to_offer
title: Request to offer: a dated route from a customer request through supplier quotes to the company's own offer, with RFQ and reminder texts and the selling price
